name: inspect_binary_hardening
description: Inspect compile-time and link-time hardening of one explicit local ELF, PE, or Mach-O file, including one image per universal Mach-O slice. Reports PIE or ASLR, NX, RELRO, stack-protector signs, FORTIFY signs, control-flow flags and stripped state, each with the header field or import behind it. States are enabled, disabled, partial, unknown, or not_applicable. A missing import in a static or stripped image is unknown, not disabled. Authenticode and Mach-O code-signature rows report table or load-command presence, not validity. Mach-O hardened runtime stays unknown and names inspect_signature. This inspection states that it does not execute the image and does not assess exploitability. Reads a stable regular file. A malformed header returns no partial report, except one bad slice in a universal Mach-O. A symbol table, symbol name, or GNU property note over its budget leaves those rows unknown and keeps the header rows. A dynamic-table budget still fails the ELF report.

parameters.description: Advertised in reduced form by the compact input schema profile; the server still validates complete canonical inputs.

max_file_bytes.description: Maximum stable artifact bytes to read (default 64 MiB)

path.description: Absolute filesystem path to an ELF, PE, or Mach-O image
